title: 2005 AMC 12A Problem 7
statement: Square \(EFGH\) is inside square \(ABCD\) so that each side of \(EFGH\) can be extended to pass through a vertex of \(ABCD.\) Square \(ABCD\) has side length \(\sqrt{50},\) \(E\) is between \(B\) and \(H,\) and \(BE = 1.\) What is the area of the inner square \(EFGH?\)

solutions.text:
By the symmetry of the figure, triangles \(ABH,\) \(BCE,\) \(CDF,\) and \(DAG\) are congruent right triangles. Hence \[ \begin{aligned} &BH = CE = \sqrt{BC^2 - BE^2} \\ &= \sqrt{50 - 1} = 7. \end{aligned} \]

Since \(E\) lies between \(B\) and \(H,\) the side of the inner square is \(EH = BH - BE = 7 - 1 = 6.\)

Therefore the area of \(EFGH\) is \(6^2 = 36.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: By symmetry the four corner triangles are congruent right triangles
In right triangle \(BCE,\) the leg \(CE = BH = \sqrt{BC^2 - BE^2}\)
